digest.component_or_area: Pandoc markdown conversion and wiki rendering
propositions: _convert invokes _pandoc_timeout on every unit call, triggering redundant git rev-parse --show-toplevel subprocesses via load_config and repo_root, resulting in 886 extra git probes across 884 conversions.

Timeout resolution is a session/render-pass invariant with no per-unit caller dependency; resolving once at render_markdown_to_wiki boundary and threading it through optional parameters preserves all caller behavior including direct test callers and per-unit fallback.
All 884 production Pandoc invocations, byte-exact outputs, timeout configurability, per-unit fallback, and process-group reap behavior must remain unchanged after the fix.
Held-out oracle with three units asserts exactly one _pandoc_timeout resolution per render pass; defect-seeded mutation confirms the invariant is enforced by test coverage.
